result_text:
The region overview now lists open tickets high priority first, then normal, then low, oldest first within each priority. Closed tickets and other regions are still excluded.

- **`DataStore.java`** (`findOpenSupportTicketsOfCustomersInRegion`, ~line 5277): the query now calls `.highestPriorityFirst()`, the same sort the sales rep's list uses. I also updated its Javadoc to describe the new order. This method has no other callers, so nothing else changes.
- **`RegionManagerTest.java`**: added `openTicketsOfTheRegionAreListedHighestPriorityFirstThenOldest`, which reproduces your example (T-1 to T-5, plus a closed high-priority ticket) and asserts `T-3, T-5, T-2, T-4, T-1`.

`RegionManagerTest`, `SupportTicketTest` and `TicketsPerSalesRepTest` pass offline (6, 5 and 3 tests, no failures). I didn't run the full suite. Nothing is committed.
